settings.title: Print Trail
settings.description: The connection to the Print Trail API, webhooks, shipping methods and SKU health.
settings.restartHelp: Credentials come from environment variables. Changing one needs a restart.
settings.secretHelp: Test connection fetches the webhook secret from the Print Trail API and stores it. PRINT_TRAIL_WEBHOOK_SECRET is only needed for a Print Trail API that doesn't return it.

webhook.heading: Webhook
webhook.rotateBody: Print Trail will sign new webhooks with a new secret. The plugin stores it straight away and accepts the old one for 4 hours.

rotated.not-registered: Print Trail doesn't send this channel's webhooks to this store, so the secret wasn't rotated.
rotated.unsupported: This Print Trail API can't rotate the webhook secret. Rotate it in the Print Trail app, then press Test connection.
rotated.secret-not-stored: Print Trail rotated the secret, but it couldn't be stored. Press Test connection to fetch it.
rotated.busy: Another Print Trail connection check is running. Try again in a moment.

webhook.secretNotStored: The webhook is registered, but the webhook secret couldn't be fetched or stored. Press Test connection again.

sku.heading: SKU health
sku.noUnmatched: Every SKU matched at the last check.
sku.unchecked: {{count}} variants haven't been checked yet. Saving a variant checks it.
sku.lastRunNever: No stock sync has run yet.

syncNow.unavailable: Stock sync is turned off in the plugin's options.
syncNow.deferred: A stock sync is already running. This one runs after it, within one sweep.
syncNow.disabled: Stock sync is turned off, or the plugin isn't connected.
syncNow.dropped: Nothing to sync: the stock is already up to date.
syncNow.requestFailed: Something went wrong: {{message}}. The last stock sync below shows how the run ended.

warning.duplicate-sku: More than one inventory item resolves to these SKUs, so their stock wasn't written: {{skus}}
warning.multi-location: These SKUs' stock went to more than one stock location (set stockLocationIds to choose): {{skus}}
warning.unknown-figure: Print Trail sent no usable stock figure for: {{skus}}

options.heading: Options in force
options.help: Set in medusa-config.ts and read at startup.
options.autoComplete: Complete orders when everything has shipped

empty.heading: Connect Print Trail
empty.body: Set these environment variables, add both blocks to medusa-config.ts and restart Medusa. Then put the products Print Trail fulfils in a shipping profile served by a Print Trail shipping option.
empty.addOption: Add a Print Trail shipping option

diagnosis.not-configured: Not connected: the Print Trail API credentials aren't set.
diagnosis.token-invalid: Print Trail refused the connection: the API token or channel ID is wrong. Check PRINT_TRAIL_API_TOKEN and PRINT_TRAIL_CHANNEL_ID.
diagnosis.channel-inactive: The Print Trail channel is inactive. Print Trail refuses every request from it and sends it no webhooks. Make it active in Print Trail (Settings → Channels), then press Test connection.
diagnosis.channel-not-found: Print Trail has no channel {{channelId}}. Check PRINT_TRAIL_CHANNEL_ID.
diagnosis.not-print-trail: The endpoint answered, but it isn't the Print Trail API. Check PRINT_TRAIL_BASE_URL.
diagnosis.token-other-channel: This token belongs to Print Trail channel {{tokenChannelId}}, but the store is configured for {{channelId}}.
diagnosis.unreachable: Couldn't reach the Print Trail API. It may be down; try again shortly.
diagnosis.error: The Print Trail API returned an error: {{detail}}

actions.already-registered: The webhook is already registered here.
actions.cannot-register: The webhook wasn't registered: the channel couldn't be read.
actions.invalid-url: The webhook wasn't registered: Print Trail never accepts this address. See the notes under Webhook.
actions.failed: Print Trail didn't register the webhook: {{detail}}
actions.busy: Another Print Trail connection check is running. Try again in a moment.

webhook.confirmUnsafe: Print Trail only sends webhooks to https:// addresses on a public host, and refuses to register any other. {{url}} isn't one, so Print Trail will refuse it unless it's a development Print Trail or the bundled mock. For a local store, use an HTTPS tunnel and set MEDUSA_BACKEND_URL to its address. Register it anyway?
webhook.confirmElsewhere: Print Trail is currently sending this channel's updates to {{url}}. Send them to this store instead?

warnings.no-webhook-secret: No webhook secret yet, so every webhook is refused. Press Test connection to fetch it.
warnings.webhook-secret-mismatch: PRINT_TRAIL_WEBHOOK_SECRET differs from the secret the Print Trail API returned. The plugin uses Print Trail's; remove the variable or update it.
warnings.no-backend-url: MEDUSA_BACKEND_URL isn't set, so the webhook can't be registered.
warnings.no-admin-url: MEDUSA_ADMIN_URL isn't set, so Print Trail orders carry no link back to Medusa.
warnings.no-admin-email: No admin email is set (PRINT_TRAIL_ADMIN_EMAIL), so nobody is emailed when a cancel comes too late.
warnings.in-memory-locking: Locks are per process. If this store runs more than one server or worker process, configure Medusa's Redis locking provider (@medusajs/medusa/locking-redis), or two processes can send the same order at once.
warnings.postgres-locking: The Postgres locking provider is the default, and the plugin doesn't support it: it never reclaims an expired lock. Use @medusajs/medusa/locking-redis.
warnings.postgres-locking-configured: A Postgres locking provider is configured. Don't make it the default: the plugin doesn't support it.
warnings.no-print-trail-shipping-options: No shipping option uses Print Trail yet, so no order is sent.
warnings.not-https: Print Trail only sends webhooks to https:// addresses, and refuses to register any other.
warnings.local-address: This is a local, private or reserved address. Print Trail can't reach it and refuses to register it; for a local store, use an HTTPS tunnel.
warnings.too-long: This address is longer than 200 characters, which Print Trail never accepts.
warnings.credentials: This address has a user name or password, which Print Trail never accepts.
warnings.fragment: This address has a #fragment, which Print Trail never accepts.
warnings.undeliverable: This address is registered, but Print Trail API 1.2.0 and later deliver nothing to it. Register an https:// address on a public host (an HTTPS tunnel for a local store).

health.reconnectBody: Print Trail refused the connection: the API token or channel ID is wrong. Check PRINT_TRAIL_API_TOKEN and PRINT_TRAIL_CHANNEL_ID, restart Medusa and press Test connection. Orders, cancels and edits waiting meanwhile are retried automatically once it works.
health.channelInactive: The Print Trail channel is inactive
health.channelInactiveBody: Print Trail refuses every request from this channel and sends it no webhooks, so orders aren't sent. Make the channel active in Print Trail (Settings → Channels), then press Test connection. Orders, cancels and edits waiting meanwhile are retried automatically once it is active.
health.unmatched: {{count}} SKUs aren't known to Print Trail.

shipping.title: Print Trail shipping
shipping.description: Calculated shipping options priced by weight band. Each option ships with one Print Trail method in one currency.
shipping.deleteBody: The shipping option is removed from checkout. Orders already placed keep it.
shipping.empty: No Print Trail shipping options yet.
shipping.name: Name
shipping.bandsHint: Each band's limit is in grams and includes the limit. Leave the last band's limit empty for no limit. Prices are as charged, for example 3.95.
shipping.countriesHint: A destination listed here is priced from its own bands; any other destination from the weight bands above. Saving keeps them as they are. You can remove a country here, which also clears one the card can't accept. To change a country's bands, or the currency of a card with countries, send the whole card through the Admin API (see the plugin's README).
shipping.methodsFallback: Print Trail couldn't be reached, so its four standard methods are offered.

errors.openBandNotLast: Only the last band can have no limit
errors.weight: Use a weight in grams above 0
errors.ascending: Each limit must be above the one before
errors.price: Use a price of 0 or more
errors.ambiguousComma: Write this without a thousands separator: 1250 or 1.25
errors.countriesCurrency: Some countries' bands have no price in this currency. Change the currency through the Admin API with every country priced in it, or remove those countries.

order.title: Print Trail
order.notSent: Not sent to Print Trail yet
order.cancelWarning: Print Trail has already started on this order. Cancelling it in Medusa may not stop these fulfilments:
order.resendAsNew: Resend as a new Print Trail order
order.resendAsNewTitle: Send as a new Print Trail order?
order.resendAsNewBody: Print Trail cancelled {{number}} and won't reopen it. This creates a new Print Trail order, {{next}}, with the same items.
order.dismissBody: This clears "{{label}}" from the order. It doesn't change anything at Print Trail.
order.dismissBodyPreOrderInactive: This clears "{{label}}" from the order. It doesn't change anything at Print Trail: the order still waits until the product is made active there. It isn't flagged again while the product stays inactive; if a sync sees it go back on pre-order or live first, it is flagged again when it is next made inactive.
order.dismissBodyPrintTrail: This clears "{{label}}" from the order. It doesn't change anything at Print Trail. This also resolves the order's other returned, failed or partly dispatched states as they are now, so they aren't flagged next. A parcel that fails or is returned later, or the order coming back to one of these states, is still flagged.
order.busy: Print Trail is busy with this order; try again shortly
order.noFulfilments: Print Trail hasn't split this order into fulfilments yet.

refused.already-confirmed: This order is already confirmed with Print Trail.
refused.cancelled-in-medusa: This order is being cancelled at Print Trail.
refused.print-trail-cancelled: Print Trail cancelled this order. Use Resend as a new Print Trail order.
refused.not-cancelled-at-print-trail: Only an order Print Trail cancelled can be sent again as a new order.
refused.already-reissued: This order has already been sent again as a new Print Trail order.
refused.order-canceled: The order is cancelled in Medusa.
refused.changed: The order changed meanwhile. Refresh the page and try again.
refused.busy: Print Trail is busy with this order; try again shortly
refused.not-dismissable: This can't be marked as resolved.

outcome.confirmed: Sent and confirmed with Print Trail
outcome.not-confirmed: Sent to Print Trail but not confirmed: {{reason}}
outcome.retrying: Couldn't finish with Print Trail; it will retry. {{reason}}
outcome.held: Every Print Trail item is held back, so nothing was sent

order.dismissUnchanged: Nothing to clear: it was already resolved

fulfilment.outOfStock: Back-order: out of stock at Print Trail

variant.title: Print Trail
variant.notInProfile: This product isn't in a Print Trail shipping profile, so Print Trail doesn't fulfil it.

stock.printOnDemand: Print on demand ({{available}} in the warehouse), backorders on
stock.preOrder: On pre-order at Print Trail; backorders on, so it can be bought at 0 stock

variant.hint: Leave empty to use the variant SKU. Print Trail matches SKUs case-insensitively, so set this only for a SKU that is genuinely different.
variant.numericOverride: This override was saved as a number, so leading zeros may have been lost. Save it again as text.

attention.title: Needs attention
attention.description: Print Trail orders the plugin couldn't finish on its own.
attention.retryCap: Stopped retrying ({{action}}). Use Resend to try again.
attention.ptFulfilment: A fulfilment is {{status}} at Print Trail

codes.pt-order-missing: Print Trail can't find this order

codes.pt-not-fulfillable: Print Trail can't fulfil this order
codes.pt-partially-fulfillable: Print Trail can fulfil only part of this order

codes.medusa-fulfilment-failed: Medusa refused a fulfilment for a dispatched parcel
codes.medusa-complete-failed: Medusa refused to complete the order

codes.dispatched-after-cancel: Print Trail dispatched after the cancel

codes.stock-shortfall: Print Trail is short of stock

codes.cancel-too-late: Cancelled too late: Print Trail had already shipped

codes.unmatched-skus: Print Trail doesn't know some SKUs

codes.auth-failed: The API token or channel ID is wrong; waiting to retry once it's fixed
codes.channel-inactive: The Print Trail channel is inactive; waiting to retry once it's active

codes.shipping-method-unavailable: The shipping method isn't available for a fulfilment

codes.not-fulfillable: Print Trail can't fulfil the order
codes.pt-errors: Print Trail reports errors on the order
codes.missing-lines: Print Trail is missing some lines

codes.target-refused: That Print Trail order can't be sent
